title: Useful Enchantments
description: The modification adds 20+ useful enchantments to Minecraft, without unnecessary additions, keeping with the Minecraft vibe.
body:
My modification adds **20+** additional, useful enchantments to Minecraft, which the player can obtain by enchanting as well as from treasure chests. Below is a list of my enchantments!
The player begins with a Useful Enchantments Guide, where they can find information about each enchantment added by the modification.
Compatible with [Enchantment Descriptions](https://modrinth.com/mod/enchantment-descriptions).

**⚠️ If you are afraid of blood 🩸 _(hemophobia)_, check this in the book - blood will not appear!**

------------------------------------
# -= Enchantments =-
![Enriched](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/521702d9b48a418f08b4c4e7b42f265a4fb1f0cc.png)
⛏️ _Additional resource drops. The higher the level, the more resources you receive._ **(I-III)**

![Smelting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1ee955a57e7ed138ca85f942ebf169d25918fbcb.png)
⛏️ _Automatically smelts ores after mining one. Compatible with Fortune and Drill._

![Withered](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0eb514fee59ac6fc7402aeca6234cd66d421d8b7.png)
⚔️ _Gives the enemy the Wither effect, lasting longer depending on the enchantment level._ **(I-II)**

![Gliding](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2bc08279f074d9d2d58701cd8d22c1032f1e00e0.png)
👞 _Makes the player fall slowly when falling from a height._

![Hardened](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/71845bcf513693e33d6a1ca9d2eca86cd1758c98.png)
🦺 _Player does not receive knockback when hit by a mob or another player._

![Unearthed](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d10fe5bf0764b0603a14508e24322ec6318f34ea.png)
🪏 _Materials such as bones, iron, and strings drops from blocks that can be destroyed by a shovel._

![Vampirism](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2c460b2620d10f5996234e12f9bdf719ce2add1c.png)
⚔️ _When you hit a mob, you gain (I:) 33% or (II:) 50% of the HP it lost._ **(I-II)**

![Stunning](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aac22509b19ce2932e996d54d2ea04b99bb7670e.png)
⚔️ _After hitting a mob, it is stopped for a short time, lasting longer depending on the enchantment level._ **(I-III)**

![Glimmering](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/67000d265ea7a755e5ca962d80bafaf0dca5af64.png)
🪖 _You can see mobs through walls, making them easier to locate._

![Reach](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/73f6083cbd93f88691058e599ffa8d5a569861c6.png)
🦺 _It allows you to reach further, destroy blocks from a further distance, and hit mobs._ **(I-III)**

![Reduction](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/831c317da73e61adfef5cc205bb9a5a87347de10.png)
👖 _Reduces your scale, while also reducing your HP, but allows you to fit anywhere._

![Increase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/96e748c1cf8b690eb503d2d7502e8da24679dd1f.png)
👖 _Increases your scale, gives you more HP, and allows you to see the world from above._

![Long-legged](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7c0f0dd51277e609b00915977ca261e2a9b36994.png)
👖 _You have longer legs, which allows you to climb higher blocks at once._ **(I-III)**

![Lumberjack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b92ea1737fe23d676aa3bd6e5c4b26918b14089e.png)
🪓 _Destroy only the bottom block of a tree to cut down the whole tree._

![Thundershock](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/236e4c2f85d660bd938634c15efcb1b96c02f17b.png)
🏹 _There's a chance lightning will strike at the point where the arrow hits._ **(I-III)**

![Double-jumping](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f23422e63e59c328c8fa8e9d2cc640b1f7faf8a4.png)
👞 _When you use the spacebar in the air, your character will jump a second time. (I:) 1 additional jump, (II:) 2 additional jumps._ **(I-II)**

![Quick Hit](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5c25576cc4ba42894a209246f7de4465e33c4908.png)
⚔️ _Increases the attack speed of your sword, allowing you to hit mobs faster._ **(I-III)**

![Lava Walker](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b9890e6961184703de9e37dbc2960890a0fcc8f9.png)
👞 _When you step on the lava, a bridge will form under your feet, preventing you from falling into the lava._

![Humidity](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/21b6ffac10190a9c0860dc249fa644451fccc987.png)
🪖 _When you come into contact with water (rain, swimming), you get noticeable gameplay improvements._ **(I-II)**

![Experienced](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9c42ba342823c6f82a62875328bf2999b6b7182b.png)
⚔️ _When you hit a mob, you gain XP. When you kill it, you also gain bonus XP._ **(I-II)**

![Drill](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cfb2bf3373d084a46aa96b5c657ae4c9f0bc5914.png)
⛏️ _You can mine 3x3 depending on the direction you are facing, works with Fortune and Smelting enchantments._

![Nightdweller](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/38868bc978487249ccf58ac46d7e3363be137344.png)
🪖 _If you wear a helmet with this enchantment, you can see in the dark._

![Adrenaline](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/67f35d85c16f910000f80f5fa0e75a6cdc240404.png)
🪖 _When the player has less than 20% HP, they receive an adrenaline boost - speed to be able to evacuate quickly._ **(I-III)**

_Please report any bugs [here](https://forms.gle/b4BKf41nD7ztZZ2a7)!_
